headline: Petrobras Raises Aviation Kerosene Price by 7.2%
summary: Brazilian state-controlled oil company Petrobras announced a 7.2% increase in the price per liter of aviation kerosene, representing an additional R$ 0.45 per liter compared to the previous month.
why: Petrobras is one of the world's largest publicly traded energy companies, and changes to its fuel pricing directly affect airline operating costs and the broader transportation sector in Brazil.

impacts.name: Petroleo Brasileiro SA
impacts.why: A price hike increases revenue per unit sold for the producer.
